race.comment: BALDONI (2) just battled late last start over 2400m at Moe, when following on from a good third at Geelong before that. He is a dour type, who could well be looking for some cut in the ground. He is rock-hard fit, and in this modest maiden, he will be among the hardest to beat. CHURCHILL LANE (4) steps up to this trip for the first time, and was doing his best work late over 1600m at Tatura nearly 2 weeks ago. If he can switch off in the run, then he should be fighting out the finish here. ROUGH ACT (7) never ran on at all last start at Ballarat, but to be fair not many did in that race. His effort for fourth at Echuca before that is the guide to use, and he can figure in the top 4 here. CAMEGITCHEE (10) missed the kick at Moe last start, and that put paid to any chance of finishing in the money. Her runs when settling handier have been better, and with an even start from the pole position, she can make amends. THREEWINESIN (11) was not bad last time, and she is peaking now. Include.
